author: Ilike162

title: Really cute app and helps you focus
body: I wish there was more to do and more ways to decorate your garden. The accessories and decorations for the garden are way too difficult to access if you want to make it look nicer and have fun choosing a style you like. Also it would be better if it was more interactive with other users of the app, like leaving them a note at their island or claiming coins from their plants.
author: shaiiiiuii

title: Wonderful Tool!
body: I’ve been using the pomodoro method for studying for years so when I heard that there was an app that turned it into a game, I knew I had to try it. The app is even better than I expected! I have ADHD and finding energy to focus on the most minuscule of things is extremely difficult. Focus Plant helps trick my brain into thinking chores have a dopamine reward. I now find that I’m far more likely to organise my clothes and cook, knowing I’ll be collecting raindrops for my plants.
author: LadyIcing

title: Really cute and nice app to help me focus!
body: Wish the window of time for you to leave the app was a little longer than 20 seconds as sometimes I need my phone to work.Also wish there was other things to spend your droplets on since I’m kind of rich on droplets and have nothing to spend them on when the plants sleep.I also don’t have time to watch the videos as I’m trying to get things dome whenever I’m on the app...soo many ads 🥲
